subheader: The complete billing rules, so you don't need to call and ask.
lead: Each rule applies from the day you ask. None needs a support ticket, and none changes at renewal.
note: These rules apply to plans bought directly. With a written offer, the offer's terms apply for its term.

rules.title: What happens if we upgrade mid-month?
rules.bodytext: The new plan starts as soon as you choose it. Your month-end invoice shows the old plan up to that day and the new one after it, both counted in days. Nothing is charged twice, and you don't need to cancel first.

rules.title: And if we downgrade?
rules.bodytext: A downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You keep what you paid for until then. We need it in writing, and an email is enough. A downgrade can remove practitioner accounts, so it should not happen with one click.

rules.title: What if a therapist joins mid-month?
rules.bodytext: If they join on the 14th, their account is billed by the day from the 14th, at the band rate. An account closed mid-month is billed up to that day. We never round up to a full month.

rules.title: How much notice do we have to give?
rules.bodytext: One month, to the end of a calendar month. Notice received on 3 March ends the plan on 30 April. There is no minimum term and no automatic yearly renewal.

rules.title: What happens to our data when we leave?
rules.bodytext: You get a free, full export of patients, appointments, documents and invoices as CSV and PDF, whenever you ask. We keep your data readable for 60 days after the last day, in case you need it later. Then we delete it and confirm this in writing.

rules.title: When is a refund due?
rules.bodytext: In the first 60 days, you get the plan price back for any reason, as described in our guarantee. After that, a monthly plan ends with the notice period, and yearly invoices are not partly refunded. One-off work is never refunded, but we only charge for it once it is done.
